externalSource.injectedBy: Cloudflare Web Analytics automatic beacon injection
externalSource.failureShape: The beacon's web-vitals build dereferences a missing navigation/TTFB entry as undefined.startTime.

productionCsp.browserConsoleBeforeFix: Loading the script 'https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/...' violates the following Content Security Policy directive ... The action has been blocked.

classification: Third-party Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon, not application code. The admin CSP already blocks it; no application state or API contract is involved.
regressionGuard: PointOfSale.Web/src/architecture-tests/aiProductGenerationBoundary.test.ts asserts the admin CSP never allows cloudflareinsights and that application diagnostics never introduce reportAllChanges/startTime.
residualRisk: If Cloudflare Web Analytics automatic injection remains enabled for the admin hostname, a browser that bypasses CSP could still execute the third-party bug. The durable external mitigation is to disable automatic Web Analytics injection for admin.shopyxi.com in Cloudflare.
